text:
sophia: Heads-up team — GAing HorizonRT-Lite (rt-lite-small, rt-lite-medium) and the Smart Failover routing policy for hosted API today. New streaming endpoint + routing header go live. :tada:

maria.p: Nice! Which endpoints are new vs. existing?

sophia: New additive endpoints: POST /v1/realtime/stream (streaming) and POST /v1/generate-rt (sync/async gen). Legacy realtime paths remain.

devex: Docs and quickstart: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/horizonrt-lite. Migration notes in the guide (header x-rw-routing-policy replaces fallback query param).

sophia: Default behavior: Smart Failover is ON for new orgs. It will pick a compatible fallback (region or quantized variant) if the primary route shows degraded health or tail latency. You can opt out per-route or set header x-rw-routing-policy: "no-fallback".

deploy-bot: Release 1888.12 started by sophia — canary 5% in eu-west-1. Monitor: https://deploy.redwood.ai/1888.12

eng-oncall: Oncall will watch canary for 72h. Alert if p95 > baseline * 1.5 or error-rate >2x. Ping #eng-oncall for issues.

product: We'll publish the external release note after canary health checks. CS/Support have the canned responses ready.

support-bot: Support playbook uploaded: https://internal.redwood.ai/playbooks/horizonrt-lite. Use template "rt-lite-customer-qa" for inbound questions.

maria.p: Quick curl example for streaming:

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "x-rw-routing-policy: prefer-low-latency" \
  -d '{"model":"rt-lite-medium","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/stream
```

product: Thanks — testing and rollout notes appreciated. If you find any canary regressions, add to the rollout board and tag eng-oncall. :rocket:
